sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone who isn't there doesn't crash — it just quietly returns nothing, and the rest of the sentence never happens.

sketches.mechanism: The 'object' keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist
sketches.resonance: Declaring something as the only one of its kind is either a love poem or a loneliness poem depending on who reads it.

sketches.mechanism: The special variable $_ is the implicit 'it' — the unnamed topic that every operation acts upon without naming
sketches.resonance: Some things are so present they never need to be named; every verb already knows its subject.
